item.name: Eternal Shroud

effects.title: Shroud
effects.text: Restores mana equal to 25% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.

effects.title: Eternal Endurance
effects.text: For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .

item.lore: A pristine hood that feeds upon strife to empower its owner.
